prediction.question: 清次の失われた記憶と、手紙の宛先はどこへ辿り着くのか？
options: 八五郎が清次の過去を知る
市松が手紙の正体を明かす
手紙の宛先は既にこの世にない

en.title: The Market of Oblivion and the Light of Compassion
en.premise: In a hidden corner of Edo, there exists a mysterious "Lost and Found Market" where one can trade painful memories for gold. Hachigoro, a kind-hearted resident of a local tenement house, happens upon an "unaddressed letter" discarded on the street. But there is a catch: the letter's author has already sold their memories, leaving them with no recollection of who the message was for or what it contained. A heartwarming tale of human connection, as the neighbors of the tenement house scramble through chaos to recover the lost words and memories.

zh.title: 遗忘之市与人情之灯
zh.premise: 在江户的一角，存在着一个名为“遗忘市集”的可疑场所，人们在那里可以将痛苦的回忆换成金钱。性格善良的长屋住户——八五郎，某天在路边捡到了一封“收件人不明的信”。然而，由于写信的人已经卖掉了记忆，他已完全忘记了想要传达给谁、想要表达什么。为了找回失落的言语与记忆，长屋里的邻里们在卷入各种纷扰的同时，展开了一场充满温情的奔走之旅。
